database_measure: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (97.5%) to NZ2114 G: 20%; C: 15%, K: 15%. H to K analog. Activity: active against Gram+ S. aureus ATCC 25923 or ATCC 6538 or MRSA ATCC 43300 (MIC 0.014-0.114 uM), S. suis CVCC3309 or CVCC3928 or CVCC606 (MIC 0.014-0.028 uM), S. pneumoniae CVCC1.8722 or CVCC2350 (MIC 0.227-0.454 uM), Gram- S-enteritidis CMCC50336 (MIC> 7.273 uM), S-typhimurium ATCC14028 (MIC> 7.273 uM), S-choleraesuis CVCC503 (MIC> 7.273 uM), S-pullorum CVCC1789 (MIC> 7.273 uM), and E-coli CVCC195 or CICC21530 (MIC> 7.273 uM). Peptide stability: stable to heat treatment for 1 h up to 100oC; resistant to proteases (Trypsin Pepsin Proteinase K). Antimicrobial robustness: pH-insensitive (pH 2-10) after 4 h. NaCl-insensitive (50-500 mM). In vitro Toxicity: up to ~5% hemo.lytic at 128 ug/ml. Recombinant production:yeast:Pichia pastoris: expressed and purified in a fermentor.
database_subject: Design and pharmacodynamics of recombinant NZ2114 histidine mutants with improved activity against methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus.
